name: web-black-and-yellow-marketplace-scroll-in-laptop-frame
title: Tall black-and-yellow page scrolling out of a laptop screen on a dark navy field
whatItIs: A laptop on dark navy with a browser window taller than the screen showing the tape-ticker hero, chip cloud, 'BUILT FOR BRANDS' heading and a yellow real-time tracking block extending beyond the frame.
whatItMeans: Bold and clear; extending the page above the laptop shows the whole flow.
techniques: Let the page extend above the laptop.
Keep yellow as the only bright colour.

vocabulary.definition: A page that extends past its device.
The frame and toolbar of a browser.
A bright block presenting a feature.
